description: An RVR system's readings as STDDS's APDS feed sends them, two figures in hundreds of feet ("35" is 3,500 ft; "00", "FF" or blank none), each with whether it is the system's most: AIM 7-1-13's readouts run 'to a maximum value of 6,000 feet', so a reading of 6,000 is '6,000 or more'.

readings.description: Each part's reading as sent (touchdown, midpoint, rollout ...), in any order.

ft.description: The reading, ft; null where the part reports none.

more.description: The system's most, 6,000 ft or more (AIM 7-1-13).

readings.description: Each reading, in the order given.
